title: Set up controlled local Qwen CLI sidecar
businessObjective: Provide private low-risk preprocessing without granting local AI authority over code, production data, or decisions.
technicalObjective: Add fail-closed local-ai wrappers, Qwen policy/benchmark documentation, JSON result validation, and a hardware/runtime audit.
assumptions: No local model runtime or Qwen model is currently installed.
No model download is authorized by this task.
Codex Qwen routing remains separate from this sidecar until local-only operation is proven.
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware/runtime/model audit records exact observations without guessing identifiers.
Controlled wrappers emit structured, schema-valid, unverified results and fail closed when runtime/model is unavailable.
PII masking, input limits, timeouts, read-only defaults, no-production boundaries, and deterministic validation are enforced.
Benchmark records Qwen/Luna/Terra correctness, duration, and verification success, including blocked outcomes.
solEscalationTriggers: Any model download, external network access, credential use, or production data request.
Any ambiguity in PII masking, runtime isolation, model provenance, or benchmark correctness.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only sidecar/docs/schema files; never delete existing model files or runtime installations.

stateTransitions.reason: High-risk local AI scope approved for shadow mode.
